label.description: Visible label. It also names the thumb.

value.description: Controlled value. Leave it out for uncontrolled use.

onValueChange.description: Called on every change while dragging or pressing keys.

onValueCommit.description: Called once a drag is released, a key changes the value, or a mark label is clicked.

step.description: Value increment. Values snap to it.

largeStep.description: Distance for PageUp, PageDown, and Shift with an arrow. Defaults to a tenth of the range.

marks.description: Detents. A dragged thumb clicks into each one and holds for about 7px. Labelled marks print under the track and can be clicked.

format.description: Formats the readout, the value tag, and aria-valuetext.

showValue.description: Shows the value beside the label. The tag over the thumb still appears while dragging or using keys.

startIcon.description: Icon before the track. It is pushed outward when the track is pulled past the start.

endIcon.description: Icon after the track. It is pushed outward when the track is pulled past the end.

name.description: Submits the value with a form through a hidden input.

disabled.description: Blocks pointer and keyboard input and removes the thumb from the tab order.
